solution.text: In <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>EMW</mi></math>, Average energy density due to electric <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><msub><mi>U</mi><mi>e</mi></msub></mfenced></math> and magnetic <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><msub><mi>U</mi><mi>m</mi></msub></mfenced></math> fields is same.
